scope: Synthetic admission and real nonprivileged Linux process group and storage checks. Two local PVC mounting identities compare owned file permissions on a deliberately shared writable test claim. The selected comparison Pod uses supplemental groups without fsGroup to avoid changing shared ownership. The report's top-level version and image describe the v1.36.1 base cluster. Supplemental Linux disk-backed emptyDir profiles use v1.37.0. Compare matching and mismatched API-server and kubelet feature gates, then verify fsGroup on the enabled node.
